featured.rule:
### Event Rules for Participants  
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots.  
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event. 
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is strictly prohibited.  
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* All Other TruckersMP Rules Apply.  

### Event Rules for Event Staff  
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.  
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.  
* All Other **[TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules)** Apply.

-----
- Only Event Staff are able to use the following words or phrases in their player tag; NWCC, NWCC | Lead, NWCC | Tail, NWCC | Supervisor, NWCC | Media, NWCC | GM Support

- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park at the 'Public Parking'.
- Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly manner.

-----
# Event Rules for Event Staff:
-----
- Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- All other [TruckersMP rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

* **Başlangıç Noktası:** Cenevre-Kathode
* **Bitiş Noktası:** Nürnberg-Kathode

today.rule:
⚙️ Konvoy Kuralları (Rules):

Bu konvoyda tüm TruckersMP kuralları geçerlidir. 🧭
Lütfen güvenli ve keyifli bir sürüş için aşağıdaki ek kurallara da dikkat ediniz:

🚫 Sollama Yasaktır.
🚫 Cars (Arabalar) Kullanmak Yasaktır.
🚫 Scout Araçları yalnızca etkinlik yönetim ekibine aittir.
🚫 Troll, spam, ani durma veya kural ihlali yapanlar konvoydan uzaklaştırılır.
🚫 Aşırı hız yapmayın, grubun temposuna uyun.
🚫 Far ve korna spamlama yasaktır.
🚫 CB Radyo’yu gereksiz konuşmalar için kullanmayın.
✅ Takip mesafesini koruyun ve öndeki tıra dikkat edin.
✅ Etkinlik yöneticilerinin ve CC (Convoy Control) ekibinin talimatlarına uyun.

Kurallara uymayan sürücüler, etkinlikten çıkarılabilir.
Hedefimiz güvenli, düzenli ve eğlenceli bir sürüş! 🚛💨

⚙️ Convoy Rules (EN):

All TruckersMP rules apply during this event. 🧭
Please follow the additional rules below to ensure a safe and enjoyable convoy:

🚫 Overtaking is strictly forbidden.
🚫 Cars (Scout vehicles) are not allowed.
🚫 Scout vehicles are reserved only for Event Staff.
🚫 Trolling, spamming, sudden braking, or rule violations will result in removal.
🚫 Do not overspeed, follow the convoy leader’s pace.
🚫 No horn or high beam spam.
🚫 Keep CB Radio clear and avoid unnecessary chatter.
✅ Maintain safe distance from the truck ahead.
✅ Always follow Event Staff and CC (Convoy Control) instructions.

Drivers who fail to comply with these rules may be removed from the event.
Let’s enjoy a safe, respectful, and fun convoy! 🚛💨

today.name: MOVEMBER AWARNESS LTR CONVOY!
today.description:
## MOVEMBER AWARNESS LTR CONVOY! 👨💙
- Oficiální konvoj ke připomínce Movemberu a měsíce mužů!
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/Hvo81kw.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. The CARGO is restricted for Beverages and Coffee.
7. Only blue trucks and trailers are allowed.
8. Confirm your participation.
9. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
10. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, however we will use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **19:30** - Meet at the parking slots in Mannheim.
*  **20:00**  - Departure from the Mannheim, Parking Slots.
*  **20:20**  - Passage around the city of Paris.
*  **20:45**  - Onboarding on Eurotunnel Train.
*  **20:50** - Departure from the train towards London.
*  **21:00**  - Passage around the city of Southampton.
*  **21:20**  - Passage around the city of London.
*  **21:55** - Arrival to the City of Manchester.
*  **22:00** - Final group photo and end of the convoy.



![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/EiyD0zj.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Mannheim, Transinet - Manchester, WGCC.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## ALL PARKING SLOTS:

![](https://i.imgur.com/X4jZN2Q.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)

today.name: TCCR Monthly Convoy #43 -  4TH ANNIVERSARY
today.description:
# 🟦🟥 TCCR 4TH ANNIVERSARY

## “Choose Your Route”  

Four years of making history, building a community and creating unforgettable events…  
Today, it’s your turn to choose your destination.  

Inspired by **The Matrix**, you’ll have two options:  
🔵 The Blue Route  
🔴 The Red Route  

Both routes will take you to the same destination… but the journey will depend on your decision.  

---

## 📅 General Information  

🗓 **Date:** NOv 22, 2026  
🕒 **Meeting Time:** 18:00 UTC  
🎉 **Truck Fest:** 19:00 UTC  
🚛 **Departure Time:** 19:30 UTC  
📍 **Final Destination:** Budapest  
🧩 **DLC Required:** Going East!  
🌐 **Server:**  

---

# 🔵 BLUE ROUTE  

### “Stay in the Comfort Zone”  

📍 **Departure:** Katowice  

A strategic, elegant and organised route.  
Perfect for those who rely on structure and coordination.  

---

# 🔴 RED ROUTE  

### “Discover the Truth”  

📍 **Start:** TruckersMP HQ  

An imposing start, straight from the heart of the simulation.  
For those seeking presence and character from the very first kilometre.  

---

# 🎉 Truck Fest & Awards – 4th Anniversary  

Both routes will converge in **Budapest** to celebrate our grand **official Truck Fest**, where we will reward excellence and community commitment.  

## 🏆 Official Categories  

🥇 **Best VTC Attendance**  
The VTC with the highest confirmed participation and presence at the event.   
 
🚛 **Best VTC Parking**  
Organisation, alignment, discipline and presentation during the Truck Fest.  

🤝 **Best Partner Attendance**  
Special recognition for the partner with the greatest support and presence.  

🌟 **Best Public Truck**  
The independent driver with the most creative, eye-catching and well-presented truck.  

---

## 🎊 Why is this event different?  

Because we’re not just celebrating years…  
We’re celebrating perseverance.  
We’re celebrating evolution.  
We’re celebrating community.  

Four years don’t come around every day.  
And this anniversary won’t just be a convoy…  

It will be history.

### Blue Event supervised by: TCCR Events  [![](https://zupimages.net/up/25/42/ejjs.png)](https://tccrgroup.cc/discord)

### Red  Event Supervised by Orvion Convoy Control
[![](https://i.imgur.com/Mj9uXv5.jpeg)](https://discord.gg/Qyjbvu2Ygt)

### Real Ops Created and implemented by: TCCR Events  [![](https://zupimages.net/up/25/42/hjjo.png)](https://tccrgroup.cc/discord)

Event Rules for Participants:

The Event Staff are recognized as Vanguard | CC, Vanguard | EM, Vanguard | , Vanguard | Media,Vanguard | Tail, Vanguard | Lead, Vanguard | GM or similar.
Impersonating Event Staff using the above-mentioned tags is forbidden.Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Overtaking is prohibited.
Participants must haul a trailer.
Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park at the **Public Parking** slot.
Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
Cars and Buses are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.

Event Rules for Event Staff:

Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
Event Staff are permitted to park out of bounds as long as it is on the ground and not on top of a building or other inappropriate placesdeemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
All other TruckersMP rules apply.
